source_en: Sorry, I look tired. Irina Kakulia, student nurse at the care home.
I live with my grandmother now. Mzia, the seamstress, southern block.
My brother went east for work. Someone had to stay with her.
Old, not sick. She says she's fine, the way she says her stitches are straight.
My [[infected:hands shake a little]]. The air, I think. Or bad energy on the ward.
I'm trying. ...There. It passes if I breathe through it.
Something from the ward cabinet, to sleep. Nobody counts the bottles anymore.
Breathe, Officer. You're holding it in.
